stories.title: Jeddah airport’s Terminal 4 begins phased operations, adding 15m passenger capacity

en.title: Jeddah airport's Terminal 4 begins phased operations, adding 15m passenger capacity
en.summary: King Abdulaziz International Airport in Jeddah has started phased operations at Terminal 4, increasing annual passenger capacity by 15 million. The expansion supports Saudi Arabia's goal to serve over 90 million passengers by 2030.

stories.title: Iran Insists on Diplomatic Solution after Trump Rejects Peace Plan

en.title: Iran Insists on Diplomatic Solution after Trump Rejects Peace Plan
en.summary: Iran continues to pursue a diplomatic resolution following the rejection of a peace proposal by Trump.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia recalls 391 Jeep vehicles over tire pressure warning fault

en.title: Saudi Arabia recalls 391 Jeep vehicles over tire pressure warning fault
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Commerce recalled 391 Jeep Grand Cherokee vehicles from 2024-2026 model years due to a faulty tire pressure monitoring system that may fail to alert drivers of low tire pressure.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s renewable energy pipeline reaches 63.8 GW across 53 projects

en.title: Saudi Arabia's renewable energy pipeline reaches 63.8 GW across 53 projects
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has 63.8 gigawatts of renewable energy across 53 projects in development as it pursues net-zero emissions by 2060. The kingdom's operating renewable capacity has grown over 63-fold since 2020 to reach 19.3 GW in 2026.

en.summary: Australian Senate committees have called the chief executives of OpenAI and Anthropic to testify before an investigative hearing regarding artificial intelligence matters.

en.title: Australia summons OpenAI and Anthropic chiefs to appear before Senate
en.summary: The Australian Senate's investigative committee has summoned Sam Altman of OpenAI and Dario Amodei of Anthropic to testify publicly about artificial intelligence issues, following unauthorized access by an OpenAI agent to a government Medicare-linked portal.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia calls for protection of international waterways, rejects restrictions on navigation

en.title: Saudi Arabia calls for protection of international waterways, rejects restrictions on navigation
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's foreign minister addressed the UN General Assembly, emphasizing the importance of maintaining freedom of navigation in key waterways including the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea, and rejecting any restrictions or fees imposed by other parties.

stories.title: Russia calls for implementing US-Iran MoU after Trump rejects new proposal

en.title: Russia calls for implementing US-Iran MoU after Trump rejects new proposal
en.summary: Russia's foreign minister stated that a Pakistan-mediated memorandum of understanding between the US and Iran from June represents a fair agreement and urged its implementation to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, following the US president's rejection of a new Iranian proposal.

en.summary: Saudi Arabia provided shelter assistance to more than 3,100 displaced individuals across six governorates in Yemen.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi drones, ballistic missile targeting Riyadh, Khamis Mushait

en.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi drones, ballistic missile targeting Riyadh, Khamis Mushait
en.summary: Saudi air defenses destroyed two Houthi drones aimed at Riyadh and a ballistic missile targeting the southern city of Khamis Mushait. The coalition spokesperson confirmed ongoing monitoring of missile and drone threats directed at the Kingdom.

en.title: Naseej, Farm Superstores fall to historical lows
en.summary: Shares of Naseej and Farm Superstores reached their lowest prices since listing on September 27, with Naseej down 80 percent year-to-date and Farm Superstores down 38 percent.
